ResultRule: Validate typed ordered24 Probe/Want links, recompute Matches via exact Got comparison, preserve panic and return counters, accept completion-with-differences as finite observation but report All24WantsMatched separately. Invalid final remains marked when valid partial prefix is selected. No missing result becomes zero observed API calls.
TimeoutRule: One process group SIGKILL at60s, exactly one joined Wait, no retry; exact total return deadline after kill/wait is not guaranteed.
ResourceRule: Darwin time-l whole-child real/user/sys and byte RSS/footprint nullable; child initialization included, controller excluded. Heap setting is not RSS hard cap. Raw logs and private paths never enter safe public ledger.
AfterRaceSourceChange: Only controller-main CPU/softheap settings; checked by final vet/build.
